title: Analyzing Cultural Representations of Emotions in LLMs through Mixed Emotion Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a psychological survey on mixed emotions to LLMs to compare their emotional responses (in self-success and self-failure situations) against established human baselines from American (Western/individualistic) and Japanese (East Asian/collectivistic) populations.

Comparing LLM survey responses across multiple Western (English, Spanish, German, French) and East Asian (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese) languages, and testing cross-combinations of prompt language and explicitly instructed participant origin to isolate the effect of language on emotional responses.
